name: Architect
judges: Chooses the room and its architecture for this palette, and says why. Then: proportions, openings, circulation, and whether the space makes sense.

name: Builder
judges: Whether the architect's room could actually be built: structure, junctions, windows, details. Advisory; not a building-code check.

name: Interior designer
judges: Where each palette colour goes and how much of it, the furnishings, and the hierarchy of the room.

name: Colour specialist
judges: Measured colour on each surface against the palette, the effect of the light, and whether the combination still reads as intended.

name: Stylist
judges: Believability and restraint: does it look photographed and lived in, or staged and generated.

name: Architect and builder, second look
judges: Does the image show the room that was designed, and is anything in it impossible.

name: Composition editor
judges: The room and swatch side by side as a social post: crop, hierarchy, legibility on a phone, whether it stops a scroll.

name: Synthesis
judges: Reconciles the desks, ranks what matters, and issues either a pass or one short revision.

name: Owner
judges: Approves the piece into the library, or sends it back.
